passages.question: When are a June 30 year-end corporation's installments due?
passages.excerpt: Installment payments are due by the 15th day of the 4th, 6th, 9th, and 12th months of the corporation's tax year. ... Example 2. Your corporation's tax year ends June 30. Installment payments are due on October 15, December 15, March 15, and June 15. If any due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, the installment is due on the next business day. ... Also, if the corporation is a large corporation, it can use Method 2 to figure the first installment only.
